contracts: Bus.check_atomic32 is a permission-only probe before an actual LR read, successful-SC write, or RMW read/write. Default is no additional policy; all device effects still occur through normal accessors.
RecordingBus and the S31 adapter forward this hook without inventing a memory-access fact. A failed SC with no reservation has no access/probe.

C5 validated-ROM/APM profile permits supported internal RAM and guest-configured/ready mapped Quad PSRAM only, with constrained actual CPU context. IO/unknown/alignment failures precede any data consumption; other profiles retain previous behavior.
LR requires read, SC requires write, RMW requires both; probe rejection delivers the correct instruction-class access fault before register or memory commit.

The priced and ordinary C5 UART negative control keeps its RX byte and emits no TX byte. Positive RAM changes17to18, returns17 and records exactly2 data-access facts in priced execution; rejection records0.
